_about: Great History Makers Ep01 (v4): Napoleon, from artillery officer to Saint Helena. 66 s approved narration (Ep02 ElevenLabs take, voice Max, already paid; unchanged), 9 AI illustrations + 5 animated maps. Preview with stand-ins: preview_temp/.

groups: He rose from an artillery officer
to become the most feared / ruler in Europe.
and his empire / reshaped the continent.
only to find much of the city / burning.
and bitter cold / devastated his forces.
At Waterloo, / his army was defeated.
This time, exile meant / a remote island in the Atlantic:
the consequences / of his own ambition.

beats.cue: He rose from an artillery officer

illustration.framing: cinematic low-angle wide shot, the young officer standing on the left third of the frame on an earthwork gun battery, full figure, gunners and a bronze field cannon behind him, harbour and fortress far below on the right
illustration.scene: Siege of Toulon, December 1793, young artillery captain Napoleon Bonaparte pointing toward the enemy forts, gunners ramming a cannon, gabions and powder smoke, British warships in the harbour
illustration.lighting: dawn light from the right, warm orange rim light on smoke, cool blue shadows

illustration.framing: cinematic medium-wide shot from the nave, the emperor in the centre of the frame on the altar steps raising a golden crown above his own head, Gothic arches and candles framing him, onlookers blurred on both sides
illustration.scene: coronation in Notre-Dame de Paris, 2 December 1804, Napoleon crowning himself, Pope Pius VII seated behind him, crimson and gold banners, incense haze
illustration.lighting: shafts of window light from high on the left, warm candle glow, deep red and gold palette

illustration.framing: extreme cinematic close-up, face filling the upper half of the frame, three-quarter view facing right, both eyes clearly visible and sharp, eyes looking into the distance
illustration.scene: Napoleon at the height of his power, cold ambitious gaze, a map of Europe and candlelight reflected faintly in his eyes, dark tent interior behind
illustration.lighting: single warm candle key light from the lower left, deep shadows, dramatic chiaroscuro

illustration.framing: epic wide shot from a hill above the river, the city skyline across the middle of the frame, sky filling the upper half
illustration.scene: Moscow burning, September 1812, the Kremlin towers, Ivan the Great bell tower and onion domes silhouetted against towering flames and black smoke, embers in the air, a few French soldiers watching from the riverbank in the foreground
illustration.lighting: night, furious orange firelight reflected in the Moskva river, red smoke clouds
illustration.negative_extra: modern buildings, Cathedral of Christ the Saviour, skyscrapers

illustration.framing: wide shot along a snowy road receding to the horizon in the centre, upper half grey sky
illustration.scene: the retreat from Russia, November 1812, exhausted French soldiers in torn greatcoats and blankets trudging through deep snow, abandoned cannon and broken wagons half buried, dead horses, birch forest, falling snow, no single hero figure
illustration.lighting: overcast freezing light, desaturated blue-grey palette with small warm accents

illustration.framing: epic wide battlefield panorama, horizon slightly above the middle, French Imperial Guard columns in bearskins advancing up a muddy slope in the foreground toward red-coated British lines on the ridge
illustration.scene: battle of Waterloo, 18 June 1815, cuirassiers charging on the flank, cannon smoke, eagle standards and vertical tricolour flags, the farm of La Haye Sainte in the distance
illustration.lighting: late afternoon storm light breaking through dark clouds, golden rim light on smoke

illustration.framing: wide shot, the lone figure small on the left third standing on a high basalt cliff edge, seen from behind in three-quarter view, endless ocean filling the right of the frame
illustration.scene: Napoleon in exile on Saint Helena around 1820, looking out over the South Atlantic, wind in his coat, steep volcanic cliffs, Longwood house small in the distance
illustration.lighting: dusk, low sun on the horizon, apricot and violet sky, long shadows

illustration.framing: monumental low-angle shot, the arch centred and filling the middle of the frame, the avenue leading toward it in the foreground
illustration.scene: the Arc de Triomphe in Paris, commissioned by Napoleon in 1806, 19th-century Paris rooftops, horse-drawn carriages on the avenue, tricolour flag beneath the vault
illustration.lighting: golden sunset light through the arch, warm haze
illustration.negative_extra: cars, modern traffic, street lamps of today, people in modern clothing

illustration.framing: close symbolic still life, the object in the lower middle of the frame, dark sea and night sky above
illustration.scene: Napoleon's black bicorne hat resting alone on a wet black rock by the sea at night, Saint Helena cliffs faint behind, waves breaking softly
illustration.lighting: cold moonlight from the upper left, faint warm glow on the gold trim, deep blue palette
